headline: The industries we run are the data we run on.
intro: Clarity Group isn't six unrelated businesses under one holding company. Four subsidiaries run real physical operations — construction, facilities, manufacturing, manpower. Two subsidiaries exist to turn what those four do every day into software and decision-grade intelligence, then apply it back into the next deployment. That loop compounds with every site we run — it's the part of the business a pure-software company or a pure operator can't replicate on their own.

flywheelStages.label: Field Operations
flywheelStages.description: Durabuild, CFM, Clarity Manufacturing, and Clarity E&C deploy certified people and assets on real, active sites across multiple countries. Every deployment, every shift, every piece of equipment produces operational signal as a byproduct of the work itself.

flywheelStages.label: Proprietary Data
flywheelStages.description: Lenix's BuiltSync synchronizes live site data across every project so every subsidiary reads from one operational truth. Pilot Data runs telemetry pilots that turn raw field signal into forward operational forecasting.

flywheelStages.label: Intelligence Layer
flywheelStages.description: Techsphere converts that operational data into decision-grade intelligence — re-engineering legacy workflows into connected, data-driven systems, and running the infrastructure layer the rest of the portfolio depends on.

closing: This is still early. The data infrastructure — real-time sync, systems integration, telemetry pilots — is live today. Applying data science and predictive modeling on top of it is the direction the group is building toward next, on a foundation most industrial operators don't have and most software companies can't build without owning the field operations underneath it.
